hook: Three questions about the last three weeks. Pause, guess... and comment your score.
q1: Question one. Which running back has the most touches since week five? Bijan Robinson, Bucky Irving, Derrick Henry, or Jonathan Taylor?
a1: Bucky Irving. Sixty-nine touches. That's a workhorse.
q2: Question two. The highest scoring quarterback per game. Josh Allen, Joe Burrow, Drake Maye, or Patrick Mahomes?
a2: Drake Maye. Thirty point six a game. Mahomes? Nine point two.
q3: Last one. The top tight end since week five. Trey McBride, Isaiah Likely, Brock Bowers, or George Kittle?
a3: Isaiah Likely. Fifty points. More than Bowers and Kittle.
verdict: The verdict... draft day names lie. Recent usage doesn't.
